answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network forms an oasis of trust via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing paired with topological cut verifications. Honest validators audit sparse cut-sets across transaction graphs; if clustered forged identities attempt a coordinated takeover, their collateralized stake burns to an ember. Because cut density mandates superlinear attacker cost, hostile subgraphs face an escalating slash spiral that makes mass forgery unprofitable.
